title: Bloodstained Hallway Painting
description: A dimly lit artist's studio contains a wooden desk with a radio, cup, and keys. A large surreal painting leans against the wall, depicting a brutal scene in a blood-splattered hallway where a uniformed man strikes a victim with an axe while another man holds the victim.
prompt: A moody artist's studio with a wooden desk holding an old radio, cup, and keys in the foreground. A massive painting leans against the wall showing a horrific violent scene inside a long institutional hallway with green walls, where a man in dark uniform and cap swings an axe into a victim's head as blood sprays and pools on the floor, another man restrains the victim, dramatic overhead lighting with red emergency glow, cinematic and unsettling atmosphere.
